instruction.task: Complete remaining Phase 1 gaps from Slice 1 and Slice 2.
instruction.objective: Close foundational gaps before deeper workflow execution: user administration, full client lifecycle, template CRUD, and contract/template resolution behavior.

section.title: 1. Auth and User Administration Completion
section.requirement: Implement Admin-only user creation backed by Supabase Auth and ERP user records. Do not store passwords in ERP tables.
Implement GET /api/users and PATCH /api/users/:id for PM/Admin visibility and Super Admin role-sensitive updates.
Add frontend/backend hooks for Supabase password reset email flow where required. Do not implement custom password hashing.
Normalize auth errors for missing bearer, expired token, inactive user, missing ERP user, and forbidden role.

section.title: 2. Client Lifecycle Completion
section.requirement: Implement GET /api/clients/:id and frontend client detail screen showing profile and linked Month 1 workflow summary.
Implement PATCH /api/clients/:id with DTO validation, tenant ownership checks, and activity logging.
Implement PATCH /api/clients/:id/status using canonical values active, paused, completed, archived.
Implement DELETE /api/clients/:id as soft archive. Archived clients must be hidden from default client lists.
Add client list search/filter by name, industry, service type, and status.

section.title: 3. Scope Template Completion
section.requirement: Implement create, update, list, detail, and deactivate endpoints for active tenant scope templates.
Implement exact industry + service_type resolution, same-industry fallback, same-service fallback, and manual PM selection.
Show KPI framework and duration in frontend preview, not only task list.

logic.description: Supabase Auth owns password storage and reset. ERP users store identity/profile/role only.
Every user, client, and template query must filter by authenticated tenant_id.
Every user, client, and template mutation must append an activity log.

item.req: Admin user creation, user listing/update, password reset delegation
Detail, edit, status change, archive, search/filter
CRUD, deactivate, resolution fallback, KPI preview
Super Admin and PM allowlists from permissions_matrix.md

instruction.first_principles_check: A user must be a Supabase Auth user plus ERP user row. A client must remain tenant-owned, auditable, and lifecycle-controlled. A template must be active, tenant-owned, and explicitly selected or resolved before operational work starts.
